# poseidon-maldi <img src="man/poseidon_logo.png" align="right" width="280" />

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

This repository contains the code to replicate the results in the paper

> "Multiomics Tissue Segmentation via Spatially-Informed Nested Biclustering Methods"  
>  by F. Denti, C. Balocchi, V. Denti, and G. Capitoli.

The manuscript is currently under review, and a draft is [available on arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.02482). 
In this repository, you can also find the `R` packages `Poser` and `Poseidon`, which implements the variational inference algorithm and the auxiliary functions used in the analyses. For instruction on how to install the packages, refer to [this section](#sec:install).

### Structure of the repository

----

#### Simulation Study Folders

Folders with names starting with `Simulation_` contain code to replicate the simulation studies presented in the paper. The `R` files in the each folder have to be ran in alphabetical order. An additional `README` file, explaining how to run the competitors, is contained in the `Simulation_VaryingSpatial_competitors`.

In particular, 

- `Simulation_Biclustering_recovery/` contains the code to replicate the results of Supplementary Section S.
- `Simulation_Study_Times/` contains the code to replicate the results of Supplementary Section S.
- `Simulation_Study_CAM_drawback/` contains the code to replicate the results of Supplementary Section S.
- `Simulation_Study_Poseidon_vs_Pose/` contains the code to replicate the results of Supplementary Section S.
- `Simulation_VaryingSpatial_competitors/` contains the code to replicate the results of Supplementary Section S.

#### CRCC data analysis folder



### Installing packages {#sec:install}

You can install the `Poser` and `Poseidon` packages by running

```{r, eval = FALSE}
install.packages("R_packages/Poser_0.0.2.tar.gz", repos = NULL, type="source") 
install.packages("R_packages/Poser_0.1.0.tar.gz", repos = NULL, type="source") 
```

which install them from their binary files.

### Problems

In case of a problem with the code, please open an issue in this repository, at [this link](https://github.com/Fradenti/poseidon-maldi/issues).
